profile.name: Eugene Dela Gogah
profile.headline: Junior Cybersecurity Analyst
profile.subheadline: Computer Science Student & Future Cybersecurity Engineer
profile.summary:
Highly motivated tech enthusiast with a strong foundation in
              computer science and a passion for innovative technologies.
              Building secure, creative digital solutions.
profile.about_text:
I'm Eugene Dela Gogah, a highly motivated CS student at GCTU
                with a deep passion for cybersecurity and innovative
                technologies. My journey began building robotics and IoT
                projects in secondary school and has evolved into a
                comprehensive pursuit of offensive security and modern web
                development.

Along the way, I’ve developed a strong foundation in
                problem-solving and hands-on experimentation, often learning by
                breaking, fixing, and improving systems. Whether it's analyzing
                vulnerabilities in controlled environments or building secure
                applications from scratch, I enjoy diving deep into how systems
                work beneath the surface.

I’m particularly interested in the intersection of security and
                user experience, where functionality meets trust. For me, it’s
                not just about finding flaws, but understanding how to design
                systems that are both resilient and intuitive for real-world
                users.

I believe technology is most powerful when both secure and
                beautifully designed. I combine analytical thinking with
                creative execution, tracing vulnerabilities on Kali Linux or
                crafting pixel-perfect interfaces for the web. I actively seek
                internships, part-time or remote opportunities where I can
                leverage my technical skills and enthusiasm for the digital
                world to make a real impact.

experiences.organization: Makatob IT Securities × Cisco Networking Academy
experiences.description:
Enrolled in intensive cybersecurity training cohort in
                partnership with Cisco Networking Academy. Building hands-on

Completed Introduction to Cybersecurity and Cybersecurity
                  Essentials (Cisco Curriculum).

Hands-on labs: vulnerability assessment, threat modeling, and

Network security: IP addressing, SSH, firewalls, and intrusion

experiences.description:
Self initiated 12-week intensive cybersecurity challenge, one
                project per week, publicly documented on LinkedIn and GitHub.
                Demonstrates initiative, consistency, and practical
                problem-solving.
bullets:
Week 1: Build a Basic Vulnerability Scanner:
                  Identify open ports and common system weaknesses.

Week 2: Set Up a Virtual Lab with VMs:
                  Configure isolated environments for safe testing.

Week 3: Network Packet Sniffer: Capture and
                  analyze network traffic.

Week 4: Password Strength Analyzer: Evaluate
                  and enforce strong password policies.

Week 5: Simple Intrusion Detection System:
                  Monitor and detect suspicious activities.

Week 6: Firewall Setup: Configure rules to
                  control incoming and outgoing traffic.

Week 7: Security Log Analyzer: Parsing
                  Ubuntu auth.log and ufw.log, JSON reports + matplotlib/seaborn
                  visualizations.

Week 8: Malware Sandbox Analysis Framework:
                  VirtualBox VMs (Ubuntu 22.04 + Kali Linux observer, host-only
                  network).

Week 9: Threat Feed Aggregator: Collect and
                  unify threat intelligence from multiple sources.

Week 10: SIEM Dashboard: Visualize and
                  monitor security events in real-time.

Week 11: Incident Response Automation:
                  Automate detection and response to security incidents.

Week 12: Final Security Audit: Conduct a
                  full system security review and report findings.

Tools: Nmap, Wireshark, Burp Suite, Metasploit, OpenVAS,
                  Python, Kali Linux and many more.

8+ weeks completed with public documentation on LinkedIn and
                  GitHub.

experiences.role: OT Cyber Resilience Workshop Attendee - Professional Development
experiences.description:
Attended a specialized Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Control System (ICS)
                cyber resilience workshop focused on critical information infrastructure protection. 
                Developed a foundational understanding of securing physical infrastructure,
                 including power grids and industrial environments, against modern threat vectors.
bullets: Framework & Compliance Exposure: Engaged with industry-standard frameworks including IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and the Ghana Cybersecurity Act 2020 (Act 1038).
Zero-Trust Architecture: Explored Cybershield’s seven-pillar Zero-Trust capability ecosystem covering OT visibility, endpoint defense, and secure data exchange.
Industrial Monitoring: Evaluated passive, non-disruptive monitoring methodologies (Augur) and industrial protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, and OPC-UA.

projects.title: Security Log Analyzer
projects.description:
Python-based tool parsing Ubuntu auth.log and ufw.log. Generates

projects.title: Malware Sandbox Analysis Framework
projects.description:
Isolated malware analysis environment using VirtualBox VMs —

                automated behavioral analysis.
